heading: Research
intro: Most of my work is experimental: small, carefully controlled behavioral studies with clearly specified questions, tasks and measures. The common thread is cognitive control — what it is, how it is measured, and how early emotional experience and current distraction affect it.
Each project below lists its methods and status. Full methods, analyses and materials are given on the project page.
projectsEmpty: Further projects will be added here as they progress.
